_comment: Realistic 118-tool, 5-server MCP catalog for the end-to-end harness (tests/harness). Ported from docs/audit/experiments/catalog.py (#301).

tools.name: create_issue
tools.description: Create a new issue in a GitHub repository with a title, body, labels and assignees.

tools.name: get_issue
tools.description: Get details of a specific issue in a GitHub repository, including comments count and state.

tools.name: list_issues
tools.description: List issues in a GitHub repository with filtering by state, labels, assignee and sorting options.

tools.name: update_issue
tools.description: Update an existing issue: change title, body, state (open/closed), labels, assignees or milestone.

tools.name: add_issue_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to an existing issue or pull request.

tools.name: search_issues
tools.description: Search for issues and pull requests across GitHub repositories using GitHub search syntax.

tools.name: create_pull_request
tools.description: Create a new pull request from a head branch into a base branch.

tools.name: get_pull_request
tools.description: Get details of a specific pull request including mergeable state and head/base refs.

tools.name: list_pull_requests
tools.description: List pull requests in a repository filtered by state, head, base and sort order.

tools.name: merge_pull_request
tools.description: Merge a pull request using merge, squash or rebase method.

tools.name: get_pull_request_files
tools.description: Get the list of files changed in a pull request with patch hunks.

tools.name: get_pull_request_diff
tools.description: Get the unified diff of a pull request.

tools.name: get_pull_request_status
tools.description: Get the combined status of all CI status checks for a pull request head commit.

tools.name: create_pull_request_review
tools.description: Create a review on a pull request: approve, request changes or comment, with optional inline comments.

tools.name: request_copilot_review
tools.description: Request an automated Copilot code review for a pull request.

tools.name: update_pull_request_branch
tools.description: Update a pull request branch with the latest changes from the base branch.

tools.name: create_branch
tools.description: Create a new branch in a GitHub repository from an existing ref.

tools.name: list_branches
tools.description: List branches in a GitHub repository.

tools.name: list_commits
tools.description: Get the list of commits of a branch in a GitHub repository.

tools.name: get_commit
tools.description: Get details for a single commit including files changed and stats.

tools.name: get_file_contents
tools.description: Get the contents of a file or directory from a GitHub repository at a given ref.

tools.name: create_or_update_file
tools.description: Create or update a single file in a GitHub repository with a commit message.

tools.name: delete_file
tools.description: Delete a file from a GitHub repository with a commit.

tools.name: push_files
tools.description: Push multiple files to a GitHub repository in a single commit.

tools.name: search_code
tools.description: Search for code across GitHub repositories using code search syntax.

tools.name: search_repositories
tools.description: Search for GitHub repositories by name, topic, language or stars.

tools.name: search_users
tools.description: Search for GitHub users by username, location or followers.

tools.name: create_repository
tools.description: Create a new GitHub repository in your account or an organization.

tools.name: fork_repository
tools.description: Fork a GitHub repository to your account or a specified organization.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: List git tags in a GitHub repository.

tools.name: get_tag
tools.description: Get details about a specific git tag.

tools.name: list_releases
tools.description: List releases of a repository.

tools.name: get_latest_release
tools.description: Get the latest published release of a repository.

tools.name: list_workflow_runs
tools.description: List GitHub Actions workflow runs for a repository, filterable by branch, status and event.

tools.name: get_job_logs
tools.description: Download logs for a GitHub Actions workflow job, or all failed jobs in a run.

tools.name: rerun_workflow_run
tools.description: Re-run an entire GitHub Actions workflow run.

tools.name: run_workflow
tools.description: Trigger a workflow_dispatch event to run a GitHub Actions workflow.

tools.name: list_notifications
tools.description: List GitHub notifications for the authenticated user.

tools.name: get_me
tools.description: Get details of the authenticated GitHub user.

tools.name: list_code_scanning_alerts
tools.description: List code scanning (CodeQL) security alerts for a repository.

tools.name: list_secret_scanning_alerts
tools.description: List secret scanning alerts for leaked credentials in a repository.

tools.name: list_dependabot_alerts
tools.description: List Dependabot vulnerable dependency alerts for a repository.

tools.name: jira_create_issue
tools.description: Create a Jira issue (story, bug, task, epic) in a project with summary, description and fields.

tools.name: jira_get_issue
tools.description: Get a Jira issue by key, including status, fields, comments and changelog.

tools.name: jira_search
tools.description: Search Jira issues using JQL (Jira Query Language).

tools.name: jira_update_issue
tools.description: Update fields of an existing Jira issue.

tools.name: jira_transition_issue
tools.description: Move a Jira issue to a new workflow status (e.g. To Do, In Progress, Done).

tools.name: jira_get_transitions
tools.description: List the workflow transitions available for a Jira issue.

tools.name: jira_add_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a Jira issue.

tools.name: jira_add_worklog
tools.description: Log time spent working on a Jira issue.

tools.name: jira_get_worklog
tools.description: Get worklog entries for a Jira issue.

tools.name: jira_link_issues
tools.description: Create a link (blocks, relates to, duplicates) between two Jira issues.

tools.name: jira_get_project_issues
tools.description: Get all issues belonging to a Jira project.

tools.name: jira_list_projects
tools.description: List all Jira projects visible to the user.

tools.name: jira_get_sprints_from_board
tools.description: List sprints of a Jira agile board (active, future, closed).

tools.name: jira_get_sprint_issues
tools.description: Get issues in a specific Jira sprint.

tools.name: jira_create_sprint
tools.description: Create a new sprint on a Jira agile board.

tools.name: jira_update_sprint
tools.description: Update a sprint: name, goal, dates or state (start/close).

tools.name: jira_get_agile_boards
tools.description: List Jira agile boards, optionally filtered by project.

tools.name: jira_get_user_profile
tools.description: Retrieve a Jira user's profile by account id or email.

tools.name: jira_delete_issue
tools.description: Delete a Jira issue permanently.

tools.name: jira_batch_create_issues
tools.description: Create multiple Jira issues in one request.

tools.name: confluence_search
tools.description: Search Confluence pages with CQL or plain text.

tools.name: confluence_get_page
tools.description: Get the content of a Confluence page by id or title.

tools.name: confluence_create_page
tools.description: Create a new Confluence page in a space.

tools.name: confluence_update_page
tools.description: Update the content of an existing Confluence page.

tools.name: slack_post_message
tools.description: Post a new message to a Slack channel.

tools.name: slack_reply_to_thread
tools.description: Reply to a specific message thread in Slack.

tools.name: slack_add_reaction
tools.description: Add an emoji reaction to a Slack message.

tools.name: slack_get_channel_history
tools.description: Get recent messages from a Slack channel.

tools.name: slack_get_thread_replies
tools.description: Get all replies in a Slack message thread.

tools.name: slack_list_channels
tools.description: List public or pre-defined channels in the Slack workspace with pagination.

tools.name: slack_get_users
tools.description: Get a list of all users in the Slack workspace with their basic profile information.

tools.name: slack_get_user_profile
tools.description: Get detailed profile information for a specific Slack user.

tools.name: slack_search_messages
tools.description: Search messages across the Slack workspace.

tools.name: slack_upload_file
tools.description: Upload a file to a Slack channel.

tools.name: slack_set_status
tools.description: Set the authenticated user's Slack status text and emoji.

tools.name: slack_create_channel
tools.description: Create a new Slack channel.

tools.name: slack_invite_to_channel
tools.description: Invite users to a Slack channel.

tools.name: slack_schedule_message
tools.description: Schedule a message to be sent to a Slack channel at a future time.

tools.name: get_activities
tools.description: List recent Garmin Connect activities (runs, rides, swims) with basic stats.

tools.name: get_activity
tools.description: Get detailed data for a single Garmin activity: distance, duration, pace, heart rate, splits.

tools.name: get_activity_splits
tools.description: Get lap/split data for a Garmin activity.

tools.name: get_activity_hr_zones
tools.description: Get time spent in each heart rate zone for an activity.

tools.name: download_activity_fit
tools.description: Download the original FIT file of an activity.

tools.name: get_sleep_data
tools.description: Get sleep data for a date: sleep stages, duration, sleep score.

tools.name: get_stress_data
tools.description: Get all-day stress levels for a date.

tools.name: get_body_battery
tools.description: Get Body Battery energy levels over a date range.

tools.name: get_heart_rates
tools.description: Get resting and all-day heart rate data for a date.

tools.name: get_hrv_data
tools.description: Get heart rate variability (HRV) status and overnight readings for a date.

tools.name: get_training_readiness
tools.description: Get the training readiness score and its contributing factors.

tools.name: get_training_status
tools.description: Get training status: productive, maintaining, overreaching, acute load and VO2 max trend.

tools.name: get_race_predictions
tools.description: Get predicted race times for 5K, 10K, half marathon and marathon.

tools.name: get_max_metrics
tools.description: Get VO2 max and fitness age metrics.

tools.name: get_steps_data
tools.description: Get step counts for a date.

tools.name: get_body_composition
tools.description: Get weight, BMI, body fat and muscle mass over a date range.

tools.name: add_weigh_in
tools.description: Record a new body weight measurement.

tools.name: get_hydration_data
tools.description: Get water intake hydration data for a date.

tools.name: get_respiration_data
tools.description: Get breathing rate respiration data for a date.

tools.name: get_spo2_data
tools.description: Get pulse oximeter blood oxygen SpO2 data for a date.

tools.name: get_workouts
tools.description: List saved structured workouts in Garmin Connect.

tools.name: create_workout
tools.description: Create a structured workout (intervals, targets) in Garmin Connect.

tools.name: schedule_workout
tools.description: Schedule a saved workout on the Garmin calendar for a date.

tools.name: get_devices
tools.description: List Garmin devices registered to the account.

tools.name: get_gear
tools.description: List gear (shoes, bikes) and their accumulated distance.

tools.name: get_personal_records
tools.description: Get personal records (fastest 5K, longest ride, etc.).

tools.name: get_daily_summary
tools.description: Get the daily summary: calories, steps, intensity minutes, floors.

tools.name: get_intensity_minutes
tools.description: Get moderate and vigorous intensity minutes for a date.

tools.name: pg_query
tools.description: Run a read-only SQL SELECT query against the PostgreSQL database.

tools.name: pg_execute
tools.description: Execute a SQL statement that modifies data (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE).

tools.name: pg_list_schemas
tools.description: List schemas in the PostgreSQL database.

tools.name: pg_list_tables
tools.description: List tables in a PostgreSQL schema.

tools.name: pg_describe_table
tools.description: Describe a table's columns, types, indexes and constraints.

tools.name: pg_explain_query
tools.description: Show the EXPLAIN ANALYZE execution plan for a SQL query.

tools.name: pg_list_indexes
tools.description: List indexes on a table with size and usage stats.

tools.name: pg_table_size
tools.description: Get the on-disk size of tables and their indexes.

tools.name: pg_active_queries
tools.description: List currently running queries and locks (pg_stat_activity).

tools.name: pg_slow_queries
tools.description: Get the slowest queries from pg_stat_statements.
